---
name: Feature request / 功能建议
about: Describe an institutional pain point and a measurable outcome / 描述痛点与可验证结果
title: ''
labels: ''
assignees: ''
---

**Who has the problem? / 谁遇到什么问题？**
Describe the role, current workflow, frequency and repetitive work. 描述角色、现有流程、发生频率及重复劳动。

**Desired outcome / 希望发生什么变化？**
Give a concrete before/after example using fictional data. 用虚构资料说明改善前后的结果。

**Alternatives and evidence / 替代方案与依据**
Which existing tools or institutional requirements apply? Link official blank templates when relevant. 说明现有工具及学校要求；模板适配请链接官方空白原表，不上传个人资料。

**Acceptance / 如何验收？**
State the observable result, language requirements, permissions and data lifecycle. 说明可观察结果、中英文要求、权限及数据保留边界。
